main_text.p: Epistolam ad Polycarpum in censu scriptorum Ignatij plane prætermittendam esse judicavit, ita videlicet verbis Hieronymi acceptis, ac si nulla peculiaris ad Polycarpum data, intellecta hic ab eo fuisset Epistola; sed illa ad Smyrnæos, tum eis tum ipsi præcipuè, ut eorum Episcopo conjunctim inscripta fuisset; nec desunt hodie etiam in Ecclesiâ Romanâ hujusce Vsferij opinionis suffragatores, verbi gratia, Cardinalis Bona lib. 1. Rerum Liturgicarum cap. 22. pag. 189. ibi enim respondens Baronio verbis quibusdam Epistolæ ad Polycarpum abutenti, hæc habet Addo quod hanc Epistolam non genuinum Ignatij fœtum esse, sed supposittitium viri eruditi dudum observarunt, & ad id probandum multa afferunt non parvi ponderis argumenta. Hinc argumentum non leve deducitur adversus omnes Ignatianas Syllloges Polycarpi Epistolas; nam si Epistola Polycarpo inscripta in dubium vocatur, si incertæ est fidei, si ut spuria à pluribus rejicitur, si viri eruditi observarunt non genuinum Ignatij fœtum esse, sed suppositium, idque probarunt argumentis non contemnendis, ut asserit Cardinalis Bona, quis mihi cæterarum fidem præstiturus est? page.notes: The first line of the page continues a paragraph from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". "Syllloges" is printed with three l's and is copied as printed; it may be a printing error for "Sylloges". "Vsferij" is copied as printed. The mark before "Addo" in the italic passage is a printed symbol, not a letter; it is left out. The word "hîc" is copied as "hic". The word broken at the line end, "alia-" / "rum", is joined as "aliarum" in the text where it is printed across the line break, with the printed hyphen kept at the break.
